title: Data Export Management
subtitle: Tenant-specific library data exports, isolated branch data extraction, and asynchronous export job queue.
tenantExportCardDesc: Export an entire library tenant partition including books, patrons, loans, and financial records.
branchExportCardDesc: Extract isolated catalog and circulation datasets for a specific physical branch location.
jobQueueDesc: Monitor asynchronous data packaging jobs, verify SHA-256 integrity, and download encrypted archives.
